question: Can GyroFlight, from the Blackbox logs of the start tune alone (roll and pitch swept), choose a PID + filter candidate that an independent remeasurement in the SITL shows to meet PM >= 45 deg, GM >= 6 dB and |S| <= 6 dB on both swept axes, improve the start's missed targets, and keep every motor's hover noise band power within 1.10 x the start's, while the v2 candidate (motor band x1.45 in the v2 window) is rejected?

start.design: noisy and laggy: gains about 1.25x and the D-term lowpass 0.8x of a pilot solution; designed with the engine on pilot logs (pilot/runA, pilot/runT)

control.chosenHow: a point of the joint space that passes every engine rule on the pilot log of the start (pilot/runT/probesC3.json: predicted roll PM 53.3, pitch PM 49.3, motor max 0.934, bandwidth 0.85/0.85, axis noise 0.94/0.93); not the engine's pick on that log (gyro x0.8, D-term x1.25, 62/39/54/72 + 50/57/67); measured before Calculate with other start ticks; never imported into the app

gyroNoise.note: the protocol v2 noise test, unchanged

improvement: per swept axis: every target the start misses moves by at least the reference tolerance (PM 5 deg, GM 1.5 dB, |S| 1 dB) in the right direction; no met target is lost

motorRule.metric: per motor m (0..3): Welch band power 100-500 Hz (nperseg 1024, Hann, 50 %) of the logged motor[m] over the hover samples (every motor armed > 1001 for >= 1 s, outside every active CHIRP +-0.5 s), per contiguous run weighted by its segments (noise_metrics.py motorBandHover); ratio = median over the three candidate runs / median over the three start runs
motorRule.clip: no hover sample with any motor <= 1000 or >= 2000
motorRule.why: NOISE_ALLOWANCE (+10 %), the existing allowance of the filter advice and the joint search, applied to every motor instead of the analysed axis

pidOnly: no requirement (protocol v2's requirePidOnlyNoCandidate dropped): on the pilot the PID-only search meets both axes too; its status and predicted motor ratios are recorded as information; PASS needs the app's own PID + filter proposal

regression.expect: the new engine on the v2 start logs does not choose it; its predicted highest motor ratio > 1.10; its v2 remeasurement's hover per-motor ratio > 1.10 (protocol v3 window)
